original_target.title: Does Hermitian–symplectic imply Kähler on a compact complex manifold?

scope_comparison: The new homogeneous-manifold theorem assumes G/K with compact isotropy and a compact discrete quotient. The non-Kahler Hermitian critical metrics in 2609.08113 are on a product of Kahler surfaces with a fixed Kahler background; they refute a critical-point question rather than existence of any Kahler metric on the underlying manifold.
